lccdd.comment: Global dimensions and detector identifiers for ALFA_o1_v01

define.comment: ARC between the outer tracker (r < 1800 mm, |z| < 1345 mm) and the ECAL barrel (r > 2200 mm). Radii and lengths are the CLD_o3_v01 values: the cell optics (RadiatorCell_FinalOptimisation_o1_v01.xml) are optimised for them, so changing them needs a re-optimisation, not a rescale. They match the ALFA design (FCC reco workshop, 26 Oct 2026): 20 cm depth, ~27 cm hexagonal cells. The endcap spans ArcEndcap_position_z +- ArcEndcap_total_length/2 = 2000-2200 mm, clear of the OT barrel (|z| < 1345 mm) and of the compensating solenoid (r < 200 mm).

ARC xenon radiator working point. Baseline 2 bar: Xe matches the C4F10 index (same ring radius) at 1.98 bar, so the C4F10-optimised cells apply; 1-3 bar scan foreseen (M. Defranchis, ARC pre-demonstrator, ALFA meeting 16 Oct 2026). The ring moves by ~0.1 mrad/K at fixed pressure, so keep the temperature consistent. Ideal-gas scaling from 273.15 K, 1 atm.
ARC mirror reflectivity (flat). 1.0 = ideal, the k4geo CLD default and the value used for T02-T06; 0.90 is the realistic placeholder studied in T07.
